description: Export the official days off of a year (2023-2199) as iCalendar (RFC 5545) text for Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar: holidays, nghỉ bù, swapped days and (optionally) working Saturdays. Unannounced years omit pending days and list them in warnings.
name: vn_holidays_ics
title: Export Vietnam days off as an iCalendar file
